title: CG Health Diagnostics - Comprehensive Validation
description: Provides on-demand procedures for comprehensive health validation of the CG development and execution environment.

introduction.purpose: To be loaded when a thorough health check is needed, potentially triggered by a WARNING or CRITICAL status, or for periodic validation.
introduction.scope: Covers MCP Servers, Development Server/Client, Project Environment, and Firebase Services.

key_metrics_to_observe: All 8 MCP servers (TaskMaster, Original Firebase, Custom Firebase, Context7, Desktop Commander, Memory Server, Browser Tools Server, Browser Tools MCP) are running.
No critical errors reported by mcp-health-monitor.sh (resource usage, response times).
troubleshooting_tips: If servers are down, attempt relaunch with `/Users/benoitarchambault/Desktop/KarmaCash/mcp-management/auto-mcp-launcher.sh --check`.
Check MCP server logs in `logs/mcp/[server-name].log` for specific errors.

console_logs.look_for: Absence of critical runtime errors, successful Firebase init, normal application flow logs.

console_errors.look_for: Explanation for any errors, particularly Vite HMR issues, log sending failures, client-side Firebase connection problems (auth/network-request-failed).

network_errors.look_for: Any failed network requests that could impact application functionality.

package_json_check.look_for: Valid JSON structure, presence of key dependencies (react, firebase, vite).

firestore_read_check.look_for: Successful retrieval of the document, `exists: true`.

status_definitions.healthy: All checks pass, MCP 8/8, no critical client errors, Firebase services responsive.
status_definitions.warning: Minor issues (e.g., some client-side log errors, 6-7/8 MCP servers), but core functionality seems intact. Proceed with caution and monitor.
status_definitions.critical: Major issues (e.g., <6/8 MCP servers, critical client-side Firebase errors blocking functionality, MCP tools unresponsive). Block implementation.

action_guidelines.warning: Document issues, monitor closely during implementation. Consider rerunning specific diagnostic steps if issues persist.
action_guidelines.critical: Do not proceed. Report detailed findings, including specific failed checks and error messages. Await guidance or manual intervention.
